Body.Content:
We are increasing the maximum frequency of orchestration playbook re-evaluations by reducing the wait time from 30 seconds down to 5 seconds in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This change reached general availability today, November 17, 2026.

How does this affect me?
With this shorter interval, you get finer control over priority escalation and Bullseye pool expansion. As a result, conversations reach the right queue or specialist sooner when wait times or queue status change. Once available, you can update existing playbooks and reduce the wait time to as low as 5 seconds.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Set wait times as short as 5 seconds in Orchestration playbooks
